messages:
Maria: Taking over primary for the 12:00-16:00 UTC shift. Quick status: there is a grade-B latency spike in hosted-api region eu-west1 (seen in p99 gen). No active pager on me but customers flagged higher latencies. I'll be primary; Junaid on standby as secondary. Annotated runbook links below.

Junaid: ack. can you paste the incidentbot output?

oncall-bot: Pager triggered: HOSTED-API-P99-LATENCY eu-west1 > 1200ms x 3. Severity: P2. Alert runbook: https://playbooks.internal.redwood/hosted-api/latency

Maria: Incidentbot summary + logs in incident channel. Primary actions: 1) check throttles/queue depth 2) warm up kv-cache 3) scale frontend pool if needed. Runbooks: https://playbooks.internal.redwood/hosted-api/latency , https://playbooks.internal.redwood/kvcache/fallback

Leo: tip — look at /metrics/frontend_queue_length and /metrics/kv_cache_hitratio. if queue>250 start a temporary scaleup (see runbook step 3). Also check model routing fallback in the console.

Sam: I'm mid-deploy in eng-runtime, should not affect eu-west but FYI. If you need me to flip routing fallback to smaller model, I can.

Maria: ok trying kv-cache probe first. command to probe: ```curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://eu-west1-api.redwood.internal/kv/probe?prefix=warmup' | jq '.'``` If hitratio < 0.6, run warmup play: ```for id in {1..10}; do curl -s 'https://eu-west1-api.redwood.internal/gen?prompt=warmup' >/dev/null; done```

Junaid: noted. If warmup fails, fallback steps: 1) enable model-variant routing to quantized-variant (console -> routing -> enable) 2) increase frontend replicas by +2 (kubectl patch deployment frontend -n prod -p '{"spec":{"replicas":<new>}}') 3) escalate to infra if disk IO high.

Maria: adding quick checklist to thread so handoff later has it. Coverage gap: no on-call in APAC between 00-04 UTC today — we've flagged for future schedule but for now watch cross-region fallbacks.

sre-runbooks-bot: Bookmark: https://playbooks.internal.redwood/quickcheats/latency-mitigation ; snippets: ```kubectl top pods -n prod | sort -k2 -n``` ; ```redwoodctl scale frontend --zone eu-west1 --add 2``` 

Leo: customer impact: subset of API keys in eu-west1 seeing >2s TTFB. Recommend email ops->product if this persists >2h. For now set alert silence to 30m while we evaluate. oncall-bot: silenced by Maria for 30m.

Maria: silenced yes. Will run probes now and post results. Junaid — you're secondary, jump in if I post restart.

Junaid: happy to take over if needed. brief to next primary: check last 6h of routing decisions (console -> routing -> audit) and any recent Dedicated capacity changes. I'll add notes to the runbook.

Maria: probe done — kv hitratio 0.48, queue 312. Starting warmup script and patching frontend +2. Commands run: ```redwoodctl run-script warmup --zone eu-west1``` then ```redwoodctl scale frontend --zone eu-west1 --add 2```. Watching metrics.

Leo: good. Keep an eye on cost dashboard; revert scale once hitratio>0.7 and p99 < 500ms. If not resolving in 20m, consider model routing fallback and engage Sam to roll a smaller model.

Maria: metrics trending down — p99 from 1400ms -> 650ms after scale + warmup. I'll remain primary for 45m then hand off to Junaid. Leaving runbook pointers & commands in thread.

Sam: thanks. ping me if you need model fallback, I'll prepare canary route.

Maria: final handoff note: primary -> Junaid at 16:45 UTC. Coverage gaps noted in calendar. Threads: incident channel link https://slack.redwood/archives/incident/ABC123. Runbooks I used: https://playbooks.internal.redwood/hosted-api/latency ; https://playbooks.internal.redwood/kvcache/fallback ; https://playbooks.internal.redwood/quickcheats/latency-mitigation

Junaid: ack takeover at 16:45 UTC. I'll check again at 17:00 and close the incident if stable. Thanks team :thumbsup: 

oncall-bot: Thread marked as resolved by Maria. Incident ticket #INC-2026-412 attached.
